component.name: GeminiHarness
component.summary: A lightweight desktop wrapper for a logged-in gemini.google.com session

description.p: GeminiHarness is an unofficial Fedora tray app that opens your own logged-in gemini.google.com session in a desktop window. Sign-in is Google’s normal flow; this app does not take an API key and does not store credentials of its own. It is not affiliated with Google.

Open the window from the AppIndicator tray or an opt-in Super+G shortcut. Closing the window hides to the tray; Quit Gemini exits. Size, position, zoom, always-on-top, and size-lock persist across restarts.
The tray icon needs GNOME’s AppIndicator extension. The app runs under XWayland so window position can be restored.
Title-bar overlay reload, always-on-top, and lock window size.
